description: Create a self-contained JavaScript teaching example demonstrating callbacks, Promises, and async/await. File must be created at: /home/ga/workspace/teaching-materials/async-await-demo.js. The file should contain: (1) A header comment block explaining purpose and usage, (2) Three implementations of fetching user data from JSONPlaceholder API (https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users/1): callback-based version showing callback hell, Promise-based version using .then(), and async/await version, (3) Educational inline comments explaining WHY each approach works (not just what the code does), (4) Console.log statements to demonstrate execution flow (at least 6), (5) Error handling using try/catch or .catch(), (6) No external dependencies - only Node.js built-ins like 'https' module, (7) The code should be runnable with 'node async-await-demo.js', (8) File should be 150-300 lines long, comprehensive but beginner-friendly. The goal is to create teaching material for bootcamp students learning async patterns.
